english.title: Drive a motor vehicle not fitted with a rear seat belt on a road when child under 12 and not 150cm tall seated in rear
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, drove a passenger car, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with a rear seat belt, on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst a child under the age of 12 years and not greater than or equal to 150 cm in height was in the rear of the car and at the time a front seat, fitted with a seat belt, was not occupied by any person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(3A) and (4) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: The level of fine was raised to level two by section 24 of the Road Safety Act 2006.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) whilst a child under the age of 12 years and not greater than or equal to 150 cm in height was in the rear of the car. There was no seat belt fitted in the rear of the car. At the time, a front seat, fitted with a seat belt, was not occupied by any person.
